peg_reference.notes: Deel describes DLUSD as a USD-denominated digital balance designed to track USD value 1:1; Stripe describes it as a US-dollar-backed custom stablecoin.

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: Deel may provide promotional rewards on eligible balances; the reviewed sources explicitly distinguish those rewards from intrinsic yield or interest on DLUSD.

classification_notes: Bridge Open Issuance custom stablecoin used in Deel's closed product surface and settled on Tempo. Cash/Treasury backing comes from Bridge's issuance design; exact DLUSD reserve allocation is not inferred.
